patthana8.25:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca na saññojaniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na saññojaniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na asaṃyojaniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na saññojaniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saññojaniyo ca na asaññojaniyo ca dhammā uppajjanti, hetupaccayā.
patthana8.25:2.1: na asaññojaniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na asaññojaniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana8.25:3.1: na saññojaniyaṃ ca na asaññojaniyaṃ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca na asaññojaniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana8.25:4.1: hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe dve, avigate pañca, (sabbattha vitthāretabbaṃ.)
